signals.name: CLK
signals.description: The global synchronization signal. All transactions happen relative to its rising edge.

signals.name: VALID
signals.description: Asserted by the source to indicate that the data/control payload on the bus is stable and valid.

signals.name: READY
signals.description: Asserted by the destination to indicate it is capable of accepting the data/control payload.

signals.name: DATA
signals.description: The actual information being transferred. Size depends on the bus width (e.g. 32-bit, 64-bit).
